title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Extension, Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need hanging space for towels or robes without a hook protruding into the room all day? This traditional retractable wall hook pulls out when you need it and pushes back in for a cleaner, lower-profile look—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware.

  • Hang essentials right where you use them with a retractable rod that provides 2-1/2" of hanging space.
  • Keep a tidier wall line in tight bathrooms—it retracts to a 1" projection when not in use.
  • Supports everyday loads with a 15 lb weight capacity.
  • Match existing knobs in the room by removing the supplied knob tip and replacing it with your own cabinet knob.
  • Installs on standard interior walls using included toggle mounting hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Extension / hanging space: 2-1/2"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Installation: Drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around; includes 6/32 toggles and all mounting hardware
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
